Are you a domestic sparky looking for exceptional pay, stability, and a consistent field run? We are currently seeking a qualified  Residential Maintenance Electrician  to join a major building and asset services team based out of  Eagle Farm . 
 This position offers a premium hourly rate on a highly secure contract starting  immediately through to 2 October 2026 , with a very high likelihood of contract extension or permanent transition, based on performance and site requirements. 
  The Package & Perks  
 
 
  Premium Hourly Rate:   $70.00/hr Base + Super  (paid weekly). 
 
 
  Work Security:  Lock in a stable winter contract with a direct, high-probability pathway to extension or permanency. 
 
 
  Local Run:  Depot based in Eagle Farm, servicing a consistent local field run with zero erratic on-call requirements. 
 
 
  Mentorship & Culture:  Join a supportive, diverse, and safety-first environment where you can actively mentor the next generation of tradespeople. 
 
 
  The Work  
 This role offers a dynamic mix of domestic service maintenance and minor residential construction works across a diverse social housing and government asset portfolio. 
 
 
  Service Maintenance & Minor Works:  Deliver electrical service maintenance, fault-finding, electrical upgrades (including safety switches and smoke alarms), and "make safe" repairs to public housing properties. 
 
 
  Technical Execution:  Interpret blueprints, technical diagrams, and specifications, utilising specialised testing equipment and safety gear. 
 
 
  Digital Workflows:  Utilise hand-held electronic devices to manage job logs, data input, and office applications (Word, Outlook). 
 
 
  High-Risk Safety:  Execute daily task risk assessments with a comprehensive understanding of safe working methods regarding asbestos, lead-based products, and high-risk construction hazards. 
 
 
  Apprentice Mentorship:  Take personal responsibility for training, mentoring, and providing professional support to apprentices at all year levels. 
 
 
  What You Need  
 We are looking for a reliable, safety-conscious residential tradesperson who takes pride in quality service delivery and maintains strict compliance standards. 
 
 
  Trade Qualification:  Cert III in Electrotechnology and a valid  QLD Electrical Work Licence  (Electrical Mechanic minimum). 
 
 
  Safety Tickets:  Current LVR/CPR and Construction Industry White Card. 
 
 
  Transport:  Valid Open QLD "C" Class Driver's Licence. 
 
 
  Compliance:  Strict working knowledge of AS/NZS 3000 (The Wiring Rules), Electrical Safety Act 2002, and associated regulations. 
 
 
  Highly Desirable (Advantageous):  Data/Molex cabling experience, CCTV/Security systems knowledge, Working at Heights (WAH) ticket, or a structured Data Cabling Licence. 
 
 
  Apply Now  
 If you are a qualified Electrician looking for a premium $70/hr rate and an immediate local run, click  APPLY  to submit your resume. 
 For a confidential discussion regarding this Eagle Farm opportunity, please contact  Samuel Vella  at  samuel.vella@randstad.com.au .  Please  click here  to apply.

 Our Fleet Maintenance team leads mechanical services and scheduled vehicle inspections to ensure all heavy, medium, and light commercial fleet assets are fit for purpose. Through a best-practice, full-lifecycle management approach, we maintain equipment deployed in complex environments, ensuring our operational capabilities consistently meet organisational objectives and strict regulatory guidelines. 
 About the Role 
 Reporting directly to the Workshop Supervisor, you will play a critical role in keeping our diverse fleet safe, compliant, and fully operational. You will be responsible for conducting high-quality repairs and scheduled maintenance on vehicle appliances, pumps, systems, and associated equipment. 
 A core focus of this role is ensuring that all fleet assets comply strictly with the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR), Transport and Main Roads (TMR) legislative guidelines, the Queensland Transport Operations (Road Use Management - Road Rules) Regulations 2009, and the Transport Operations Act 1995. 
  Key Responsibilities:  
 
 
 Perform diagnostic, repair, and scheduled maintenance work on a diverse range of light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles. 
 
 
 Service and repair vehicle appliances, high-pressure pumps, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems. 
 
 
 Ensure all maintenance meets NHVR and TMR legislative compliance standards. 
 
 
 Complete accurate and timely job sheets and data entry for all maintenance activities. 
 
 
 Champion a safe working environment by strictly adhering to all Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies and procedures. 
 
 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are seeking a safety-focused and highly skilled Diesel Fitter who takes pride in producing quality work and maintaining meticulous compliance standards. 
  Mandatory Requirements:  
 
 
 Relevant Trade Qualification (Diesel Fitter / Heavy Commercial Vehicle Mechanic). 
 
 
 Ability to successfully pass a comprehensive pre-employment  Drug and Alcohol Test . 
 
 
 Ability to successfully pass a  Police Check . 
 
 
 Strong commitment to WHS practices and procedures. 
 
 
  Preferred Experience:  
 
 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience working with  High-Pressure Pumps, Pneumatics, and Hydraulics . 
 
 
 Previous experience working within NHVR and TMR compliance frameworks is highly regarded. 
 
 
 Why Join Us? 
 
 
  Monday to Friday Roster:  Enjoy your weekends and a genuine work-life balance. 
 
 
  Local Work:  Based locally in Townsville-be home every night.

result.description:
Defence & National Security Sector | Melbourne | 12-Month Contract + Extension Option   Your new company     Hays Defence Technology is seeking an experienced AI Behaviour Developer / Autonomous Systems Engineer to join a high-profile Defence research and capability development program through consultancy engagement.       This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation autonomous systems and electronic warfare simulation capabilities, working within a multidisciplinary team focused on advanced modelling, human-autonomy teaming, AI decision-making, and mission simulation.     Your new role     You will be responsible for developing and enhancing autonomous agent behaviours within an established modelling and simulation environment used to support Defence capability research and experimentation.       Working alongside specialists in software engineering, data analytics, human factors, systems integration, and simulation, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, testing and validating autonomous behaviours for teams of platforms operating in complex simulated environments.     What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Develop and enhance autonomous agent behaviours and decision-making models   
 Design and implement behaviour trees, BDI architectures, state machines, or similar autonomy frameworks   
 Develop software components using Python, C++, or related programming languages   
 Integrate autonomous behaviours into existing simulation and mission-planning environments   
 Support autonomous mission execution, task allocation and multi-platform coordination   
 Conduct testing, validation and quality assurance activities   
 Develop technical documentation and contribute to knowledge transfer activities   
 Participate in collaborative research activities with domestic and international stakeholders   
 
      What you'll get in return     
 
 NV1 clearance obtained   
 Proven experience developing autonomous agent behaviours or AI decision-making systems   
 Strong knowledge of behaviour trees, BDI models, state machines, planning systems or related autonomy frameworks   
 Software development experience using Python, C++, or similar languages   
 Experience designing robust, explainable and verifiable AI behaviours   
 Strong testing, debugging and validation skills   
 Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary technical teams   
 Excellent communication and documentation skills   
 Experience working with modelling and simulation environments   
 Knowledge of autonomous systems, robotics or unmanned platforms   
 Understanding of aerospace systems, aircraft operations or avionics   
 Exposure to Electronic Warfare (EW), Electronic Support (ES) or Electronic Attack (EA) concepts   
 Defence, research, or national security sector experience   
 
      What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to holly.powell@hays.com.au , or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
